sections.content: The repair plan vdd-quick-dev-semantic-oracle-recovery defines six dependent slices S1 through S6. Active acceptance covers semantic intent, descriptor binding, independent judging, evidence coverage, promotion protection, terminal lineage, and boundary compliance.
sections.title: Scope and acceptance

sections.content: The contract requires hash-bound predecessor artifacts, non-shell descriptors, independent execution and judging, many-to-many evidence edges, nine false-green fixture checks, and a closed terminal replay. Logs and protected platform paths are excluded from recovery and modification.
sections.title: Execution contract

sections.content: The semantic oracle validates required intent fields, taxonomy, coverage, fixture roles, and judge requirements. Run-local inputs are materialized from formal predecessor references, artifacts are identity-bound, and selected source content is summarized with bounded redaction.
sections.title: Input and verification
